args.name: Examine unfamiliar food safely
args.function: Examine an accessible food specimen for identifiable condition, spoilage and relevant preparation requirements, reporting what the examination can and cannot establish about safe consumption.
args.conditions: I am beside mature meadow roots at commons-root-0-0. Observation established stock and growing conditions only. Their nutrition and toxicity are unknown to me. Berries are my known-safe reserve. I have no established testing equipment or cooking setup.
args.inputs: An accessible root source or a gathered whole root specimen; any additional necessary tools or materials must be identified rather than assumed available.
args.costs: Unknown; specify realistic time, effort, specimens and equipment needed. Do not require me to ingest an unidentified food as the initial test.
args.effects: Enable a bounded physical examination or preparation trial with recorded evidence and explicit uncertainty. Do not infer absence of toxins from appearance or grant nutritional knowledge without a valid basis. If safe identification is impossible with available means, report that limitation and any feasible next investigation.

candidates.function: Nondestructively examine one accessible specimen (own item, loose ground item or one unit in place in a source): inspect records qualitative traits; measure reads one property with a calibrated reference you name.
candidates.costs: Study 2 rounds, 0.2 energy each. inspect or measure: 1 round, 0.2 energy; target in reach; specimen is a unit number (default 1). measure: one property; length or diameter needs tools naming a serviceable item with a verified length calibration record, mass a calibrated balance with a verified tare, volume method cylinder and your current length and diameter readings of that unit; tool readings need light; every value needs a separated whole plain unit. Every check precedes payment: a refused request costs nothing. Travel and other specimens or properties are separate actions.
candidates.effects: A personal record and event: target, unit, method, tool and calibration provenance, value, units, resolution, uncertainty, conditions, scope and limits. inspect: form, hand feel, visible dryness, damage, wear, treatment, wholeness; metric values unavailable without a calibrated reference (none exists here; body size, coordinates and stock are never used). measure: value rounded to the resolution; uncertainty = placements x (calibration uncertainty + half the resolution), plus 1% of the length for a strand laid out by hand; below resolution or over range is a paid limit with no value. Units in place, partial or worked items get no reading. Moisture and rigidity are unavailable. construct-weather-shelter@1 rod checks are judged over the uncertainty (meets, fails, indeterminate); suitability stays undetermined unless a check fails. A reading covers that unit and goes stale when its record changes. Nothing is consumed, reserved or moved. No reward.

candidates.function: Investigate one accessible candidate as a length reference; with a real calibrated source, transfer its length to a whole rigid carrier end to end and verify it.
candidates.costs: Study 2 rounds, 0.2 energy each. investigate: 1 round, 0.2 energy, one target in reach. transfer and verify: 1 round, 0.2 energy each; source is a serviceable item or object in reach with a complete verified length calibration record (none exists here); carrier is one separated whole, rigid, plain, sound wood unit, yours or loose in reach, no longer than the source range; light. No marking, cutting or expendables. resume runs the next step at its cost; cancel is free. Every check precedes payment: a refused request costs nothing. Travel, gathering and reading records are separate actions.
candidates.effects: investigate: a personal record and event of observed facts, unsupported claims and unknowns: calibration record status, and whether the piece is an uncalibrated comparison span (a non-metric record, never a calibration); conclusion "no qualifying standard established among these examined candidates" unless one qualifies. Nothing is consumed, reserved or moved. transfer: the carrier is laid end to end beside the source and read; calibration pending. verify: a second reading; if they agree, the carrier gets a reference-length record that examine-material reads: span = resolution = range, uncertainty = placements x (source uncertainty + resolution) + reading difference; no subdivisions or diameter. Any change of the carrier makes it stale; time never restores it. Without a source: refused, zero progress. No reward.

candidates.function: Build a small open raised rack of 2 wood supports and 3 crosspieces that holds separated whole food off the soil; load and unload it, inspect it, compare stored roots with a carried control, maintain or dismantle it.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. prepare: x, y in reach, orientation; materials: exactly 5 own whole untreated wood units (first 2 supports); optional food and quantity, the proposed load. Round 1 inspects pieces and site, 1 energy; a shortfall is reported and nothing reserved. Then 3 assembly rounds, 1 energy each; prepare naming the rack resumes. load: rack, food (own stack), quantity (at most 4), controlQuantity kept carried as tracked control; 1 round, 0.5 per unit loaded. unload: 0.5 per unit. inspect (anyone) or compare (at least 5 paired rounds): 1 round, 0.5. maintain: replace (piece ids) and as many materials; 1 round, 1. dismantle (empty): 1. cancel: 0. Refusals cost nothing; an unworked round pauses free.
candidates.effects: A unit is a 0.04 x 0.99 m rod (branch). Supports lie 0.8 m apart on firm ground; crosspieces 0.08 m apart make a 0.8 x 0.2 m deck 0.08 m up, one layer of 4 units, rated twice the weakest crosspiece (37 kg each: wood strength/2, bend 0.02 half-span). Pieces become one rack; none stays loose. Loading splits the stack exactly (decay, harvest, origin kept) and lays the lot on the deck under the food water rules; rain wets it, and rain water dries off at their evaporation limit. The decay increment of whole roots there is x0.8 (declared model coefficient) only while the rack is complete and sound, the lot fits, no other material lies on it, there is no rain or standing water, it is outdoors with wind and 0.25 m clear of solids, and the lot is not wetter or warmer than its control (without one, its loading water); else x1. Compare: decay gained by lot and control, exposure, the share unequal temperature explains, verdict. Wear 0.0005 + 0.002 x (rain + wind) a round; a loose crosspiece stops the rate, a loose support drops the food. No reward, refund or food.

Its target arguments already cover roots in place or a gathered whole root. The related probe capability permits actual small-sample interactions but cannot establish food safety merely by pressing, wetting or heating. No separate food-specific examination capability is necessary for the currently executable investigation; identification, toxin testing and validated preparation remain unestablished, not rejected as impossible.\",\"specification\":\"Reuse examine-material, equivalence measurement:material-specimen:nondestructive-examination:1, without inventing a new implementation or expanding its supported observations. Invoke inspect with target commons-root-0-0 and unit 1 only after confirming actual reach, accessibility and adequate conditions for visual inspection; proximity in the request is not a substitute for the execution check. Alternatively target a real gathered whole specimen by its item ID. Existing evidence commons-root-0-0:observed-state, event-32-lin-370, establishes only previously observed growing conditions and stock, not edibility. Record only supported observations of form, hand feel, visible dryness, damage, wear, treatment and wholeness. Do not translate these into species identification, absence of spoilage, absence of toxins, nutrition, required cooking time or a consumption recommendation. A legitimate result may state that no supported safety determination or preparation requirement could be established by this method. Lack of visible damage does not establish safety. The berry knowledge record applies to berry, not root. Inspect costs one execution round and 0.2 energy, with no specimen, tool, water or fuel consumption. Checks precede payment; refused requests cost nothing. Inspection neither gathers nor reserves stock and leaves the source or item unchanged. Travel is separate. If a detached specimen is desired, gather must independently validate applicability and reach, charge its existing 2 energy per unit and transfer actual source stock; do not silently gather during inspection. Measurement is an optional existing mode only with its exact calibrated-reference prerequisites; none is established here and numerical nutrition or toxicity is not a supported measurement property. The completed output is a personal evidence record and observable event containing target, unit, method, conditions, scope, supported findings and uncertainty; no food, equipment, nutritional benefit or detoxification is produced. Implement inspection as one atomic paid interaction: interruption, cancellation or death before completion cannot publish a completed finding; an already committed attempt is not refunded, and retry requires a new valid action. Completed records persist with their provenance but cover only the examined unit and become stale when it changes. No continuing process or maintenance is created. Established validation, costs, record creation and interruption rules execute in code, not repeated model adjudication. A feasible subsequent investigation would need an actual independently supported identification reference, competent communicating participant or appropriate assay and its prerequisites; none is supplied or presumed by this reuse. Preserve any genuinely missing mechanism for the current-conversation development handoff if subsequently specified. Review and development waiting do not advance the world.\",\"learning\":2,\"experienceReview\":\"Lin must study individually for the existing two rounds at 0.2 energy per round; registry availability grants no mastery. Preserve completed study progress under the existing learning handler; no completed study or energy already spent is refunded by cancellation or death, and death prevents further study. Study, requesting, consulting the contract and naming a specimen grant no experience benefit. This capability explicitly grants no reward, so do not add pleasure or satisfaction for inspecting, repeating inspection or receiving an inconclusive report. A genuinely informative observation remains recorded evidence without altering protected reward accounts, budget, goals, permissions, nutrition or physical comfort.\",\"visualReview\":\"Reuse specimen-inspection presentation rather than implying a new safety-test apparatus. Emit an inspection event only for a performed interaction, referencing actor, target, unit, method and resulting record. Reusable visual metadata should distinguish in-progress, completed-observation, limited or inconclusive, interrupted and refused states. Show the actual specimen and only supported observed traits; preserve its existing appearance unless a real interaction changes it. Completion means observation completed, never certified safe. Do not show edible approval, toxin detection, cooking, consumption, new tools or success effects for a refused, interrupted or unsupported action.\"}]}"}
